description: Inside a drive, after a round of its plays leaves questions open, close every one the drive's own sources or memory already answer — before anything is built or anyone is asked. Merges the questions asked again across plays and capabilities, answers from the sources (for a prototype: its views, journeys and page — quoted) and from memory through the memory tool (traced), and says for the rest what is still missing. The first of the drive's three knowledge member plays (Shared Drive Run, R5c); never writes the product model.
